slots.name: quote
slots.notes: The guest's line, 3 to 4 lines at 92px. One <em> = a short gold phrase (1 to 3 words). Script wraps words into spans; pre-wrap words as <span data-at="s"> for exact word timing, otherwise the slot's data-at is the first word and the rest follow every 0.28 s.

slots.name: by
slots.notes: Attribution, e.g. name, job. Lands with the orange dash after the last word.

summary: Guest quote on oxblood that fills in word by word on the spoken word (0 to 25% to 100%), one gold phrase, orange dash + attribution after the line lands.

slots.name: quote
slots.notes: Short statement, one .ln per line (max ~20 chars per line at 112px), each with data-at. One <em> in the whole quote = the gold word.

slots.name: media
slots.notes: Guest portrait (portrait aspect best), cover-cropped inside the brick panel, drifts slowly.

summary: Brand quote card: big orange opening quote mark pops first, short quote per line in cream with one gold word, guest portrait on a brick panel born from a line, small mark bottom-right.

slots.name: kicker
slots.notes: Small uppercase label over the list.

slots.name: items
slots.notes: item-1..3, each up to ~40 chars (2 lines at 60px). .item carries data-at; default 1.4 s stagger. At most one <em> across all items = the gold word. Empty items are dropped.

slots.name: media-1
slots.notes: Shot in the frame from frame 0 until item 2. Swaps hard on each item's time; 804x950 frame, cover-cropped.

slots.name: media-3
slots.notes: Shot from item 3 to the end.

summary: Numbered list builds line by line on the left (active chip orange, past items step back to 55%) beside a 14px frame whose clip swaps per item and drifts.

slots.name: kicker
slots.notes: What is being compared, uppercase label.

summary: Proof-forward before/after: deep Before panel lands, short orange rule with chevron draws across, brick After panel lands and its number flips gold.

slots.name: headline
slots.notes: One line at 84px, one <em> = the gold word.

slots.name: tiles
slots.notes: 3 to 4 .tile. tile-N label (max ~16 chars, generic tool names), note-N (max ~26 chars, optional), data-icon = chat|spark|calendar|sheet|mail|phone|camera|list, optional data-at (default 0.85 s apart). Class .key on the tile the orange connector points into (default tile 3). Layout re-spaces for 3 tiles.

summary: How they wired it: brick tool tiles with cream header strips and drawn-on line icons, joined by dashed cream connectors drawn left to right, one orange connector, headline with one gold word.
